arxiv-1908-07974.creator: E. Okyere, J. D. Ankamah, A. K. Hunkpe, D. Mensah
arxiv-1908-07974.description: Abstract In this paper, we have studied epidemiological models for Ebola infection using nonlinear ordinary differential equations and optimal control theory. We considered optimal control analysis of SIR and SEIR models for the deadly Ebola infection using vaccination, treatment and educational campaign as time-dependent controls functions.

arxiv-2101-11487.title: Kähler geometry of quiver varieties and machine learning
arxiv-2101-11487.creator: George Jeffreys, Siu-Cheong Lau
arxiv-2101-11487.description: Abstract . We develop an algebro-geometric formulation for neural networks in machine learning using the moduli space of framed quiver representations. We find natural Hermitian metrics on the universal bundles over the moduli which are compatible with the GIT quotient construction by the general linear group, and show that their Ricci curvatures give a Kähler metric on the moduli.

arxiv-2108-04336.title: The Multi-Objective Polynomial Optimization
arxiv-2108-04336.creator: Jiawang Nie, Zi Yang
arxiv-2108-04336.description: Abstract . The multi-objective optimization is to optimize several objective functions over a common feasible set. Since the objectives usually do not share a common optimizer, people often consider (weakly) Pareto points. This paper studies multi-objective optimization problems that are given by polynomial functions.

arxiv-2202-01370.title: Field-induced Topological Hall effect in antiferromagnetic axion insulator candidate EuIn 2 As 2
arxiv-2202-01370.creator: J. Yan, Z. Z. Jiang, R. C. Xiao, W. J. Lu, W. H. Song, X. B. Zhu, X. Luo, Y. P. Sun, M. Yamashita
arxiv-2202-01370.description: Abstract The magnetic topological materials have attracted significant attention due to their potential realization of variety of novel quantum phenomena. EuIn 2 As 2 has recently been theoretically recognized as a long awaited intrinsic antiferromagnetic bulk axion insulator. However, the experimental study on transport properties arising from the topological states in this material is scarce.

arxiv-2306-07751.title: Ab initio study of NaSrSb and NaBaSb as potential thermoelectric prospects
arxiv-2306-07751.creator: Chandan Kumar Vishwakarma, Mohd Zeeshan, B. K. Mani
arxiv-2306-07751.description: Abstract Zintl phases are excellent thermoelectric prospects to put the waste heat to good use. In the quest of the same, using first-principles methods combined with Boltzmann transport theory, we explored two recent phases NaSrSb and NaBaSb. We found low lattice thermal conductivity of 1.9 and 1.

arxiv-2310-08654.title: Histogram- and Diffusion-Based Medical Out-of-Distribution Detection
arxiv-2310-08654.creator: Evi M.C. Huijben ∗, Sina Amirrajab, Josien P.W. Pluim
arxiv-2310-08654.description: Abstract Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is crucial for the safety and reliability of artificial intelligence algorithms, especially in the medical domain. In the context of the Medical OOD (MOOD) detection challenge 2023, we propose a pipeline that combines a histogram-based method and a diffusion-based method.

arxiv-2310-09046.title: Laser beam properties and microfluidic confinement control thermocavitation
arxiv-2310-09046.creator: Jelle J. Schoppink, Jose A. Alvarez-Chavez, David Fernandez Rivas
arxiv-2310-09046.description: Abstract Thermocavitation, the creation of a vapor bubble by heating a liquid with a continuous-wave laser, has been studied for a wide range of applications. Examples include the development of an actuator for needle-free jet injectors, as the pumping mechanism in microfluidic channels and crystallization or nanoparticle synthesis.

arxiv-2401-08031.title: Operator Growth in Disordered Spin Chains: Indications for the Absence of Many-Body Localization
arxiv-2401-08031.creator: A. Weisse, R. Gerstner, J. Sirker
arxiv-2401-08031.description: Abstract We consider the spreading of a local operator A A in one-dimensional many-body systems with Hamiltonian H H by calculating the k k -fold commutator [ H , [ H , [ … , [ H , A ] ] ] ] [H,[H,[...,[H,A]]]] .

arxiv-2402-00937.title: Useful entanglement can be extracted from noisy graph states
arxiv-2402-00937.creator: Konrad Szymański, Lina Vandré, Otfried Gühne
arxiv-2402-00937.description: Abstract Cluster states and graph states in general offer a useful model of the stabilizer formalism and a path toward the development of measurement-based quantum computation. Their defining structure – the stabilizer group – encodes all possible correlations which can be observed during measurement. Those outcomes which are compatible with the stabilizer structure make error correction possible.

arxiv-2407-08110.title: General Electronic Structure Calculation Method for Twisted Systems
arxiv-2407-08110.creator: Junxi Yu, Shifeng Qian, Cheng-Cheng Liu
arxiv-2407-08110.description: Abstract In recent years, two-dimensional twisted systems have gained increasing attention. However, the calculation of electronic structures in twisted material has remained a challenge. To address this, we have developed a general computational methodology that can generate twisted geometries starting from monolayer structure and obtain the precisely relaxed twisted structure through a machine learning-based method.

arxiv-2505-11375.title: Anti-aliasing of neural distortion effects via model fine tuning
arxiv-2505-11375.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . Neural networks have become ubiquitous with guitar distortion effects modelling in recent years. Despite their ability to yield perceptually convincing models, they are susceptible to frequency aliasing when driven by high frequency and high gain inputs. Nonlinear activation functions create both the desired harmonic distortion and unwanted aliasing distortion as the bandwidth of the signal is expanded beyond the Nyquist frequency.

arxiv-2602-12095.title: Pack it in: Packing into Partially Filled Containers Through Contact
arxiv-2602-12095.creator: David Russell, Zisong Xu, Maximo A. Roa, Mehmet Dogar
arxiv-2602-12095.description: Abstract The automation of warehouse operations is crucial for improving productivity and reducing human exposure to hazardous environments. One operation frequently performed in warehouses is bin-packing where items need to be placed into containers, either for delivery to a customer, or for temporary storage in the warehouse.

pmc-10736135.title: THE HIDDEN TOLL OF INCARCERATION: EXPLORING THE LINK BETWEEN IMPRISONMENT HISTORIES AND PAIN AMONG OLDER ADULTS
pmc-10736135.creator: Yulin Yang, Gabriel Lutz, Chixiang Chen, Raya Kheirbek
pmc-10736135.description: ObjectiveIncarceration is linked to poor health outcomes across the life course. However, little is known whether and to what extent incarceration histories shape pain in later life. This study aims to examine the link between incarceration histories and pain outcomes among middle-aged and older adults in the United States.

pmc-11356604.title: From Lipid Signatures to Cellular Responses: Unraveling the Complexity of Melanoma and Furthering Its Diagnosis and Treatment
pmc-11356604.creator: Elisa Díaz-Grijuela, Agustín Hernández, Claudia Caballero, Roberto Fernandez, Raquel Urtasun, Marina Gulak, Egoitz Astigarraga, Miguel Barajas, Gabriel Barreda-Gómez, Paola Savoia
pmc-11356604.description: Recent advancements in mass spectrometry have significantly enhanced our understanding of complex lipid profiles, opening new avenues for oncological diagnostics. This review highlights the importance of lipidomics in the comprehension of certain metabolic pathways and its potential for the detection and characterization of various cancers, in particular melanoma.

pmc-11540568.title: Expanding the genetic and clinical spectrum of SLC25A42‐associated disorders and testing of pantothenic acid to improve CoA level in vitro
pmc-11540568.creator: Katharina Heckmann, Arcangela Iuso, Janine Reunert, Marianne Grüneberg, Anja Seelhöfer, Stephan Rust, Giuseppe Fiermonte, Eleonora Paradies, Carmela Piazzolla, Manoj Mannil, Thorsten Marquardt
pmc-11540568.description: SLC25A42 encodes the mitochondrial coenzyme A (CoA) transporter localized at the inner mitochondrial membrane. SLC25A42 deficiency leads to a congenital disease with a heterogeneous clinical presentation, including myopathy, developmental delay, lactic acidosis, and encephalopathy. Twenty‐one patients have been described so far. In the current study, we report on the identification of new biallelic variants in SLC25A42 in three siblings.

pmc-11606163.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundAtherosclerosis (AS) is the major cause of cardiovascular disease. pmc-12793903.title: Neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio and stenosis severity in ischemic stroke: Digital subtraction angiography evaluation and implications for inflammation-based risk stratification in the Indonesian population
pmc-12793903.creator: Aidil Fiqri, Nasrul Musadir, Imran Imran, Desiana Desiana, Sri Hastuti
pmc-12793903.description: Neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR), an accessible biomarker derived from routine blood counts, has been associated with stroke severity and outcomes. However, its association with angiographically confirmed stenosis has not been fully established. The aim of this study was to investigate the correlation and association between the NLR and the severity of intracranial arterial stenosis assessed by digital subtraction angiography (DSA).

pmc-13037619.title: Retrospective evaluation of surgical outcomes using traditional, internal obturator muscle flap, and sacroischial sling technique for canine perineal hernia repair
pmc-13037619.creator: Wijit Sutthiprapa, Pharkpoom Budsayaplakorn, Nattika Koatsang, Wutthiwong Theerapan, Naris Thengchaisri
pmc-13037619.description: Objectives:This retrospective study compared the outcomes of three surgical methods: traditional technique, internal obturator muscle flap, and sacroischial sling (TT, IOMF, and SS) for the treatment of canine perineal hernias. Postoperative complications associated with each technique were also compared.Materials and Methods:87 dogs (86 males, 1 female) with perineal hernia were included in this study.

pmc-13465476.title: A large-scale single-nucleus resource reveals a cardiomyocyte-like fibroblast and stage-specific remodeling across cardiomyopathies
pmc-13465476.creator: Qianzi Tang, Xingyu Li, Xiongwei Fan, Chenqing Zheng, Huihui Ma, Rong Luo, Yuanling Tang, Shengzhong Liu, Chengming Fan, Yao Zhang, Wanfeng Zhang, Xiushan Wu, Xiaoping Li
pmc-13465476.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundCardiomyopathies represent a heterogeneous group of myocardial disorders with distinct phenotypes and outcomes, yet their cell-type-specific mechanisms and differences remain incompletely defined.MethodsHere, we present the Cardiac Cell Atlas, a large-scale single-nucleus transcriptomic atlas of 525 cardiac tissue samples (20 newly generated and 505 publicly available) spanning dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM), hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM), arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy (ARVC), left ventricular non-compaction (LVNC), and non-failing controls, integrating > 2 million nuclei.ResultsThis resource delineates both shared remodeling signatures and divergent trajectories across cardiomyopathies.
